title: Evaluating the Contextual Integrity of Privacy Regulation: Parents' IoT Toy Privacy Norms Versus COPPA
reasoning: The paper evaluates the alignment of privacy regulations (COPPA) with parents' privacy norms concerning children's smart toys. Privacy norms are inherently linked to ethical considerations and societal expectations regarding appropriate data handling. The paper explicitly mentions making 'an implicit normative argument about the purpose of privacy regulation', indicating a direct engagement with ethical frameworks regarding data privacy.
